import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.next();
        StringBuilder transformed = new StringBuilder();
        int len = s.length();

        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (i + 3 <= len && s.substring(i, i + 3).equals("dot")) {
                transformed.append('.');
                i += 2;
            } else if (i + 2 <= len && s.substring(i, i + 2).equals("at")) {
                transformed.append('@');
                i += 1;
            } else {
                transformed.append(s.charAt(i));
            }
        }

        if (transformed.length() > 0) {
            if (transformed.charAt(0) == '.') {
                transformed.deleteCharAt(0);
                transformed.insert(0, "dot");
            } else if (transformed.charAt(0) == '@') {
                transformed.deleteCharAt(0);
                transformed.insert(0, "at");
            }
        }

        if (transformed.length() > 0) {
            int lastIndex = transformed.length() - 1;
            if (transformed.charAt(lastIndex) == '.') {
                transformed.deleteCharAt(lastIndex);
                transformed.append("dot");
            } else if (transformed.charAt(lastIndex) == '@') {
                transformed.deleteCharAt(lastIndex);
                transformed.append("at");
            }
        }

        int atCount = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < transformed.length(); i++) {
            if (transformed.charAt(i) == '@') {
                atCount++;
            }
        }

        if (atCount == 1) {
            System.out.println(transformed.toString());
        } else {
            boolean firstSymbol = true;
            StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder();
            for (int i = 0; i < transformed.length(); i++) {
                char c = transformed.charAt(i);
                if (c == '@') {
                    if (firstSymbol) {
                        output.append('@');
                        firstSymbol = false;
                    } else {
                        output.append("at");
                    }
                } else {
                    output.append(c);
                }
            }
            System.out.println(output.toString());
        }
        scanner.close();
    }
}
